## 02 • Bilingual news desk • Human approval only
One durable job per five-minute tick (capacity 288/day); authenticated writes and atomic job leases coordinate concurrent workers.
US$0.90/day shared server ledger. Reserve bounded maximum token cost BEFORE each Kie request, then reconcile reported credits.
NO automatic paid-call retries. Unknown paid outcomes are held for operator reconciliation.
Every article remains REVIEW. Public publication requires an editor.

## Bounded writing + evidence check
Kie.ai GPT-6 Luna • low reasoning • no tools • synchronous JSON
Reserve the full listed 128K output limit per call; request schema has no documented output cap.
English + Hindi, original headlines, summaries, source citations and metadata.
Independent second pass checks against the supplied evidence; this does not replace human fact-checking.
Pricing checked 20 Oct 2026; paid work pauses for price review after 20 Nov.

## Reference photos, no AI images
Wikimedia Commons only • reusable license allowlist • creator, source and license retained.
Byte upload into durable CMS storage. No image? Keep draft imageless with a clear editorial warning.
Photograph is illustrative, never asserted to show the reported event.

## Private review queue
Exact payload checkpoint + permanent source identity + stable ingestion key.
Safe CMS retry cannot overwrite editor changes.
Ranking/citation eligibility depends on accuracy and original reporting; no ranking promise.
